programmeSpecificReplacements.officialTitle: Bachelor of Technology in Plastics Technology

eligibleAudiences: Indian nationals meeting a specified TNEA 2026 nativity/schooling/parent-service category
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders within the specific TNEA exception
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu and meet the stated documentation rule
restrictions: This listing covers only first-year academic-stream TNEA seats surrendered by CIPET Chennai, not an independently verified foreign/NRI quota or lateral-entry route.
Indian applicants must satisfy one of the six TNEA nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or parent-service categories detailed below; an Indian passport alone is insufficient.

Tamil Nadu candidates who passed Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu may apply without a nativity certificate. Tamil Nadu natives who studied any of those classes outside the state require a digitally signed nativity certificate.

Children of Central Government employees qualify irrespective of nativity if a parent—or guardian only where both parents are deceased—served continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years; employer evidence is required.

Children of permanent public-sector or government-recognised-institution employees qualify irrespective of domicile with five continuous years of Tamil Nadu employment and the specified employer/supporting records.
Children of All India Service Tamil Nadu-cadre officers require a parental declaration. Other-state candidates who studied Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu may apply without a nativity certificate.
The parent-service and other-state schooling categories are considered under Open Competition; communal reservation requires Tamil Nadu nativity and the prescribed state community certificate.
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders may participate under Open Category, except those born in a foreign country after 4 March 2021. Do not broaden this to every OCI/PIO or foreign applicant.

Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu may participate under Open Competition with Headquarters Tahsildar identification; those outside refugee-camp registration also need original passport, visa and police-registration letter.
audienceEligibility.notes: TNEA 2026 explicitly names CIPET Chennai among participating central-government institutions. This is a positive route definition, not a declaration that the institution excludes every other applicant. NRI residence alone neither creates a verified NRI quota nor negates eligibility as an Indian national under these rules.

admissionsContent.overview: This four-year plastics-technology degree listing covers the first-year academic-stream TNEA route at CIPET Chennai. Selection uses qualifying-subject marks and online counselling, subject to the exact nationality, nativity and documentation categories.

eligibility.intro: Academic-stream applicants must meet both the CIPET programme conditions and TNEA 2026 admission rules.
items: Pass HSC Academic, both +1 and +2, or an accepted equivalent, with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
The minimum raw +2 average across Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry is 45% for General and 40% for eligible BC/BCM, MBC/DNC, SC/SCA/ST categories.
CIPET’s 2026–27 prospectus states an age limit of 21 for first-year UG entry; it does not specify the age-calculation date.
Indian applicants must meet a TNEA nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or eligible parent-service category; reserved-category claims need the prescribed Tamil Nadu documents.
Only the specified Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO and Sri Lankan Tamil refugee exceptions are established here; general foreign or NRI-quota admission is not asserted.
Vocational-stream and lateral-entry applicants are not covered by this narrow academic-route record.

applicationSteps: Register one online TNEA application and select the correct applicant/reservation categories.
Upload the required original-certificate copies, including route-specific nativity, parent-service, OCI/PIO or refugee evidence where applicable.
Review the qualifying-marks rank and complete online choice filling for CIPET Chennai, college code 1321, branch PA.
Confirm the allotted college and branch, complete the required fee payment and report with original records within the published counselling deadlines.

application: Digitally signed nativity certificate where the applicable TNEA category requires it
Employer service certificate and supporting permanent-employment records where applicable
Parental declaration for the All India Service Tamil Nadu-cadre category where applicable
Tamil Nadu community certificate for a communal-reservation claim
OCI/PIO status and Tamil Nadu nativity evidence where using that specified exception
Income/first-graduate/government-school or special-reservation certificates only when claiming the corresponding benefit
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees: Headquarters Tahsildar identification certificate
Refugees outside camp registration additionally need original passport, visa and police-station registration letter
